as_of_label: SUPERVISED CLOSE · FROZEN SUNDAY 6 SEPTEMBER 2026 EVIDENCE
h1: The slate has reach, not proof of demand
room_line: Separate campaign scale, niche affinity and local conversion before the room mistakes visibility for audience pull.
coming_kick: AGENSI leads visible reach, SUANGGI has the sharpest genre hook, and IYUS offers the clearest niche-audience test.
coming_caveat: No incoming title has captured paid sales, booked-seat movement or opening occupancy; this ranks signal quality, not known demand.
signal_note: AGENSI's captured public signal is promotion-shaped—talent-led activity, gala support and BOGOF—while IYUS is being tested through a family-time usage hypothesis. The capture protocols do not support a quantitative cross-title comparison, and neither signal establishes paid intent.

eligibility.basis: Indonesian cast, filmmakers and production houses; exact release date corroborated by the SAMS public Coming surface.

coming.meta: Enzy Storia, Afgan and Starvision: directed by Naya Anindita, with Legacy Pictures, Vortera Studios, Navvaros Entertainment and a broad comedy ensemble.
coming.logline: After losing her job, Katia starts an ethical domestic-helper agency while navigating debt, family pressure, workplace mishaps and an unexpected romance.
coming.quality: Encouraging but thin: one independent user review calls the situational comedy fresh and respectful toward ART workers, but no robust critic or representative audience verdict was captured.
coming.gold: Broadly relatable package: current anxieties around layoffs, mortgages and finding work are wrapped in accessible comedy, romance and familiar talent, although conversion remains unproven.
coming.promo: Active multi-pronged campaign: the distributor ran a participatory Afgan contest and gala-premiere activation, while TIX ID offered advance-sale BOGOF tickets for the September 10 show date.
coming.social: Visible but campaign-led attention: the captured TikTok sample reached up to 61,440 views and showed strong likes on selected cast and soundtrack posts, with little explicit watch intent or conversation.
coming.demand: Purchase access is proven, purchase strength is not: BOGOF advance tickets were directly bookable for September 10, but no sales count, seat fill, sold-out claim or organic buying rate was captured.
coming.risk: Conversion inflation risk: conspicuous BOGOF support and campaign-heavy social visibility can make launch awareness look stronger than underlying paid demand, while independent quality evidence remains narrow.
coming.bet: Paid occupancy will reach at least 80% of the normalized median for comparable Indonesian openings through Day 4.
coming.nug: A timely PHK-to-entrepreneurship story carries Enzy Storia–Afgan warmth, but the BOGOF push that lifts awareness can blur true paid conversion.

lanes.read: After losing her job, Katia starts an ethical domestic-helper agency while navigating debt, family pressure, workplace mishaps and an unexpected romance.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Two readable film profiles independently describe Katia losing her job, starting an ART placement agency and facing family and romantic complications.
lanes.decision_consequence: The accessible employment, family and romantic-comedy premise supports broad Day 0 discovery placement rather than niche positioning.

lanes.read: Enzy Storia and Afgan lead a Starvision-backed ensemble directed by Naya Anindita, with numerous recognizable actors and female comedians supporting the commercial package.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: A readable release profile names Starvision, Legacy Pictures, Vortera Studios and Navvaros Entertainment, director Naya Anindita, leads Enzy Storia and Afgan, and the large ensemble.
lanes.decision_consequence: Recognizable leads, Starvision provenance and a broad comedy ensemble justify normal visibility and make the title easier to market locally.

lanes.read: Encouraging but thin: one independent user review calls the situational comedy fresh and respectful toward ART workers, but no robust critic or representative audience verdict was captured.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The readable Kompasiana user review says the film uses fresh humor and handles PHK and undervalued ART work without ridiculing the profession.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat quality as a modest positive tiebreaker, not as grounds to expand beyond the Day 0 discovery floor before paid audience results.

lanes.read: Broadly relatable package: current anxieties around layoffs, mortgages and finding work are wrapped in accessible comedy, romance and familiar talent, although conversion remains unproven.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Readable profiles consistently foreground PHK, financial pressure, entrepreneurship, family conflict, comedy and the Enzy–Afgan pairing.
lanes.decision_consequence: Position the title as accessible contemporary comedy for general Indonesian audiences, while withholding any allocation premium until paid productivity appears.

lanes.read: Active multi-pronged campaign: the distributor ran a participatory Afgan contest and gala-premiere activation, while TIX ID offered advance-sale BOGOF tickets for the September 10 show date.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Starvision's captured post documents a user-generated-video contest tied to Afgan and the gala premiere; TIX ID directly documents bookable BOGOF advance tickets.
lanes.decision_consequence: Expect elevated launch awareness, but do not interpret campaign volume or subsidized tickets as proof of durable paid demand.

lanes.read: Visible but campaign-led attention: the captured TikTok sample reached up to 61,440 views and showed strong likes on selected cast and soundtrack posts, with little explicit watch intent or conversation.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Among ten captured TikTok results, a cast interview clip had 61,440 views and 1,223 likes, while a soundtrack clip had 10,980 views, 1,216 likes, 27 comments and 21 shares.
lanes.decision_consequence: Use social activity as proof of awareness around talent and campaign material, not as justification for extra shows without ticket or occupancy evidence.

lanes.read: Purchase access is proven, purchase strength is not: BOGOF advance tickets were directly bookable for September 10, but no sales count, seat fill, sold-out claim or organic buying rate was captured.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The direct TIX ID promotion confirms a live ticket-purchase path and BOGOF offer for the opening date.
lanes.missing_fact: Paid advance-ticket volume, site-level seat occupancy, promotion redemption and non-promotional purchase conversion.
lanes.decision_consequence: Apply the existing Day 0 discovery floor only; do not grant a demand-led uplift before owned paid-admission productivity is observed.

lanes.read: Conversion inflation risk: conspicuous BOGOF support and campaign-heavy social visibility can make launch awareness look stronger than underlying paid demand, while independent quality evidence remains narrow.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The strongest purchase-proximity signal is a subsidized BOGOF offer, and the captured social sample is dominated by cast, soundtrack, screening and promotional content.
lanes.decision_consequence: Separate paid admissions from free or discounted redemptions and require show-level productivity before holding or expanding supply after launch.

ai_rating.source_confidence: High: premise, identity and promotion are corroborated; quality rests on one user-contributed review.
ai_rating.sams_relevance: Medium-high: familiar talent and current PHK, mortgage and family themes create an accessible Indonesian comedy package.
ai_rating.demand_proximity: Low: TIX ID proves bookable September 10 BOGOF tickets, not sales, occupancy, redemptions or full-price conversion.
ai_rating.promo_social_strength: Medium-high: Afgan contest, gala and BOGOF support; TikTok peaked at 61,440 views, with little explicit watch intent.
ai_rating.risk_pressure: Medium-high: BOGOF and campaign-led reach may inflate launch signals; independent quality evidence remains narrow.
ai_rating.actionability: High: separate paid admits from BOGOF and complimentary entries, then benchmark normalized occupancy on Days 1 and 4.

eligibility.basis: Indonesian cast, director, writers and family-musical subject; the sealed SAMS public Coming capture does not list it.

coming.meta: Kevin Abadio and Creator Pictures: Babah T Bob and Wichita Satari co-star; Achmad Romie directs.
coming.logline: A grieving 10-year-old regains confidence through an imaginary companion, musical adventures and lessons drawn from Papa T. Bob’s children’s songs.
coming.quality: Quality remains unproven: the completed film has festival and invited-screening exposure and a warm child-friendly concept, but no captured independent review assesses its execution.
coming.gold: Distinct family-musical counterprogramming: an all-ages, 82-minute film using Papa T. Bob nostalgia can serve children and parents, though that niche may remain narrow.
coming.promo: Promo is active but not demonstrably converting: the campaign includes an official trailer, lyric challenge, story clips and a September 3 CGV FX screening.
coming.social: Visible social response is thin: the strongest TikTok sample reached 15,792 views but drew only 50 likes, 3 comments and 25 shares; two other posts stayed below 600 views.
coming.demand: Observable prerelease demand for IYUS JENIUS appears low: only 13 Remind Me actions were captured, and the producer-reported footprint of about 80 screens indicates limited distribution rather than demonstrated audience pull. Purchase demand remains unverified because no presale, sold-seat or ticket-sales evidence was captured.
coming.risk: Main risk is weak conversion for a narrow family musical: the three-year route to cinemas, modest reported footprint, thin social interaction and prior AI-poster controversy all counsel restraint.
coming.bet: IYUS JENIUS will open low-volume, with weekend matinees outperforming weekday and evening shows without broader slot demand.
coming.nug: Papa T. Bob nostalgia gives this child-focused musical a parent bridge; whether that bridge converts is the title’s real test.

lanes.read: A grieving 10-year-old regains confidence through an imaginary companion, musical adventures and lessons drawn from Papa T. Bob’s children’s songs.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured listing describes Iyus losing his father and confidence before Babah T-Bob guides him through songs, games and life lessons.
lanes.decision_consequence: The clear child-and-parent premise supports family matinees, but does not itself establish demand.

lanes.read: Kevin Abadio leads as Iyus, with Babah T Bob and Wichita Satari among the cast; Achmad Romie is the consistently credited director and Creator Pictures the production house.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured cast listing names Kevin Abadio and Babah T Bob, while the fetched production article identifies Achmad Romie and Gandhi Fernando’s Creator Pictures.
lanes.decision_consequence: The package has recognizable Papa T. Bob association but no captured evidence of a proven theatrical draw among the named cast.

lanes.read: Quality remains unproven: the completed film has festival and invited-screening exposure and a warm child-friendly concept, but no captured independent review assesses its execution.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: A September 3 screening report says FFW selected the film as representative of child-friendly viewing; the article provides production discussion, not an independent critical appraisal.
lanes.missing_fact: An independent review or attributable audience reaction evaluating the completed film after a screening.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not convert the appealing family tone into a quality premium; let paid Day 1 behavior test whether the execution connects.

lanes.read: Distinct family-musical counterprogramming: an all-ages, 82-minute film using Papa T. Bob nostalgia can serve children and parents, though that niche may remain narrow.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The listing gives an all-ages rating, 82-minute runtime and Family, Musical, Comedy genre; the production article explicitly positions Papa T. Bob songs as a bridge to parents’ nostalgia.
lanes.decision_consequence: Offer a conservative family-focused discovery test, especially matinees, instead of treating genre scarcity as proof of broad appeal.

lanes.read: Promo is active but not demonstrably converting: the campaign includes an official trailer, lyric challenge, story clips and a September 3 CGV FX screening.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured TikTok sample contains three recent campaign posts, while a fetched report documents the CGV FX screening shortly before release.
lanes.decision_consequence: Campaign activity warrants monitoring but not extra shows without paid demand or materially stronger audience response.

lanes.read: Visible social response is thin: the strongest TikTok sample reached 15,792 views but drew only 50 likes, 3 comments and 25 shares; two other posts stayed below 600 views.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The direct TikTok capture provides post-level views and interactions; the Instagram keyword sample was unrelated and cannot support a film signal.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat awareness as localized rather than broad momentum and require paid occupancy before increasing exposure.

lanes.read: Observable prerelease demand for IYUS JENIUS appears low: only 13 Remind Me actions were captured, and the producer-reported footprint of about 80 screens indicates limited distribution rather than demonstrated audience pull. Purchase demand remains unverified because no presale, sold-seat or ticket-sales evidence was captured.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Jadwalnonton shows 13 Remind Me actions, while Gandhi Fernando is quoted saying 25 XXI screens and about 80 screens nationally; neither proves purchases.
lanes.missing_fact: Paid presale volume, sold-seat inventory or opening-day admissions by cinema and showtime.
lanes.decision_consequence: Keep the Day 0 discovery position conservative and make paid Day 1 occupancy the gate for any expansion.

lanes.read: Main risk is weak conversion for a narrow family musical: the three-year route to cinemas, modest reported footprint, thin social interaction and prior AI-poster controversy all counsel restraint.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The screening report describes a three-year wait and producer-reported limited footprint; two fetched articles confirm an earlier AI-poster controversy.
lanes.decision_consequence: Protect downside with limited family-timed discovery shows and a fast hold-or-cut decision from paid occupancy, not campaign visibility.

ai_rating.source_confidence: Moderate: core facts are captured, but no independent review tests the finished film’s execution.
ai_rating.sams_relevance: Family-musical counterprogramming: all-ages, 82 minutes and Papa T. Bob nostalgia, but likely narrow.
ai_rating.demand_proximity: Low: 13 Remind Me actions and about 80 reported screens; no presale, sold-seat or paid-admission evidence.
ai_rating.promo_social_strength: Active but weakly converting: trailer, challenge and screening; top TikTok had 15,792 views, 50 likes and 3 comments.
ai_rating.risk_pressure: High: narrow family-musical conversion, a three-year cinema path, modest footprint and prior AI-poster controversy.
ai_rating.actionability: Paid Day 1 and Day 4 occupancy can test the family-matinee skew and whether demand spreads beyond those slots.

eligibility.basis: Indonesian cast, director, writers and local story context; the sealed SAMS public Coming capture does not list it.

coming.meta: Alghifahri Jasin / 786 Production, Rumpi Entertainment and Timur Pictures: led with Jasmin Risach and M Aqif Difullah; directed by Andi Burhamzah.
coming.logline: After their parents die, an eldest brother works as an online motorcycle-taxi driver to keep his two younger siblings housed and in school.
coming.quality: Unproven quality, grounded family melodrama: the trailer material promises hardship, affection and moments of humor, but no independent screening verdict was captured.
coming.gold: Regional family-drama proposition: its South Sulawesi creative identity and everyday survival story offer local resonance, but no evidence establishes broad national pull.
coming.promo: Confirmed exhibitor trailer support, unquantified campaign scale: Cinema XXI published the official trailer for the 10 September release, but reach and campaign breadth are absent.
coming.social: No usable film-linked social signal: all ten captured keyword posts use the generic phrase without identifying the movie, so their engagement cannot be credited to it.
coming.demand: Booking proximity without demand proof: a captured cinema guide says Delta XXI scheduled the film for 10 September, but no presale, paid-seat or occupancy evidence exists.
coming.risk: False-positive confidence is the main risk: release and promo are confirmed, but generic social engagement, missing independent quality evidence and absent paid demand leave conversion exposed.
coming.bet: Its accessible family-sacrifice premise will deliver at least median paid admissions per show versus the Indonesian new-release cohort.
coming.nug: A South Sulawesi-rooted family story with an immediately legible emotional hook—but its first real demand signal will be paid attendance.

lanes.read: After their parents die, an eldest brother works as an online motorcycle-taxi driver to keep his two younger siblings housed and in school.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: RRI's captured synopsis identifies Ulla, his two siblings, their financial pressure and his work as an online motorcycle-taxi driver.
lanes.decision_consequence: The film has a clear, accessible family-sacrifice premise that the room can position without explanation-heavy marketing.

lanes.read: Alghifahri Jasin leads with Jasmin Risach and M Aqif Difullah; 786 Production, Rumpi Entertainment and Timur Pictures are the production houses.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: RRI directly names the three principal performers, supporting cast, director Andi Burhamzah and all three production houses.
lanes.decision_consequence: This is a locally rooted ensemble rather than a demonstrated national-star vehicle, so talent alone should not justify elevated expectations.

lanes.read: Unproven quality, grounded family melodrama: the trailer material promises hardship, affection and moments of humor, but no independent screening verdict was captured.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Cinema XXI's trailer copy frames loss, family survival and humor, while RRI describes an emotionally driven family drama rooted in everyday hardship.
lanes.missing_fact: A readable independent review, critic screening report or genuine post-screening audience reaction assessing this film's execution.
lanes.decision_consequence: Use the emotional premise as positioning, but do not treat the promotional tone as evidence that the drama lands; Day 1 audience response must carry that judgment.

lanes.read: Regional family-drama proposition: its South Sulawesi creative identity and everyday survival story offer local resonance, but no evidence establishes broad national pull.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: RRI links Andi Burhamzah's work to South Sulawesi culture and describes this film as a close-to-life story about family, sacrifice and limited means.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat it as a cautious, reversible local-family play and test for geographic resonance instead of assuming national demand from an accessible theme.

lanes.read: Confirmed exhibitor trailer support, unquantified campaign scale: Cinema XXI published the official trailer for the 10 September release, but reach and campaign breadth are absent.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: A readable Cinema XXI post carries the official trailer, release date and a direct sharing prompt.
lanes.decision_consequence: Count exhibitor amplification as real awareness support, but require measurable reach or local activation before upgrading the commercial stance.

lanes.read: No usable film-linked social signal: all ten captured keyword posts use the generic phrase without identifying the movie, so their engagement cannot be credited to it.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The ten-post TikTok keyword sample contains generic greetings, lifestyle captions and unrelated hashtags, with no visible film, cast or release reference.
lanes.missing_fact: Title-specific posts or comments that clearly reference the film, plus attributable reach, sentiment and watch or purchase intent.
lanes.decision_consequence: Exclude the captured TikTok totals from the demand case and avoid presenting phrase popularity as film awareness or engagement.

lanes.read: Booking proximity without demand proof: a captured cinema guide says Delta XXI scheduled the film for 10 September, but no presale, paid-seat or occupancy evidence exists.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: JatimTimes names a 10 September slot at Delta XXI, establishing near-release scheduling at one venue but not consumer conversion.
lanes.missing_fact: Readable presale availability, paid admissions, seat-map movement or occupancy attributable to this title.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not upgrade the title on release confirmation alone; keep exposure reversible and make verified Day 1 paid performance the decision gate.

lanes.read: False-positive confidence is the main risk: release and promo are confirmed, but generic social engagement, missing independent quality evidence and absent paid demand leave conversion exposed.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The official release listing and exhibitor trailer are real, while the social sample is entirely unlinked to the film and the purchase capture shows scheduling rather than sales.
lanes.decision_consequence: The room should separate availability from audience pull, resist signal stacking and predefine an early paid-performance trigger for continuation.

ai_rating.source_confidence: High: the premise, identities, release and exhibitor trailer are directly supported.
ai_rating.sams_relevance: Medium: the accessible family story may travel, but local resonance is the sharper commercial angle.
ai_rating.demand_proximity: Partial: Delta XXI lists 10 September, but no presale, seat movement or occupancy was captured.
ai_rating.promo_social_strength: Weak: Cinema XXI amplified the trailer, while all ten TikTok matches were unrelated generic phrase use.
ai_rating.risk_pressure: High: confirmed availability and promo could be mistaken for audience pull without paid-performance evidence.
ai_rating.actionability: High after opening: Day 1 and Day 4 paid admissions per show can directly test the premise.

coming.room_question: Has any SAMS site recorded a confirmed private group booking for JANGAN LUPA BAHAGIA before opening, and if so, at which site and for how many paid seats? The answer can change its rank and evidence plan: a meaningful confirmed booking supports a higher local-fit posture, while none keeps the title evidence-constrained.

eligibility.basis: Indonesian cast, filmmakers and production houses; exact release date corroborated by the SAMS public Coming surface.

coming.meta: Pangeran Lantang, Carissa Perusset, Iwa K — Mutiara Films and Subtube Studio: supported by actors from eastern Indonesia.
coming.logline: Debt-driven homecoming unleashes a family curse when Beni returns to steal his adoptive mother's wealth and confronts Aroba's deadly Suanggi power.
coming.quality: Distinctive eastern Indonesian folk-horror texture, but quality remains unproven: captured coverage repeats claims of cultural depth, authentic sound and regional imagery without an independent screening or audience verdict.
coming.gold: Differentiated but unvalidated positioning: eastern Indonesian Suanggi folklore gives the title a fresher hook than familiar Java-centred horror, while the 21+ classification narrows the reachable audience.
coming.promo: Active late-stage digital push: ten captured TikTok results on September 5 used countdowns, cast clips, humor, podcast spillover and repeated September 10 calls to watch, but no proven ticket offer or conversion was captured.
coming.social: Visible reach with shallow conversation: the ten-post TikTok sample accumulated 51,538 views and 1,959 likes, but only 14 comments and 41 shares; the strongest post reached 24,340 views, so attention is present while intent remains unproven.
coming.demand: No demonstrated ticket demand: the title is listed as coming soon for September 10 and the captured listing displays nine reminders, but the bundle contains no bookable inventory, paid presales, seat fill or sold-out evidence.
coming.risk: Constrained-audience and false-positive risk: Dewasa 21+ limits access, while promotional reach could be mistaken for demand despite sparse comments, shares and transactional evidence.
coming.bet: Its eastern Indonesian folklore hook will create curiosity but no more than a normal discovery-floor local-horror opening.
coming.nug: Distinctive folklore, unproven conversion: 51,538 sampled TikTok views produced only 14 comments and 41 shares, while 21+ narrows access.

lanes.read: Debt-driven homecoming unleashes a family curse: Beni returns to his eastern Indonesian island intending to steal his adoptive mother's wealth, only to face Aroba's deadly Suanggi power and buried family secrets.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Fetched plot accounts consistently identify Beni's debt, concealed theft plan, return after 13 years and the supernatural retaliation linked to Aroba.
lanes.decision_consequence: The premise supplies a clear greed-versus-curse hook for the room, but narrative clarity alone does not justify allocation above the Day 0 discovery floor.

lanes.read: Recognizable leads with locally grounded support: Pangeran Lantang, Carissa Perusset and Iwa K lead a Mutiara Films and Subtube Studio production supported by actors from eastern Indonesia.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: RRI names both production houses and the principal cast; the fetched international overview corroborates the production and lead credits.
lanes.decision_consequence: The cast offers usable recognition and cultural positioning, but the bundle contains no evidence that these names independently convert into ticket purchases.

lanes.read: Distinctive eastern Indonesian folk-horror texture, but quality remains unproven: captured coverage repeats claims of cultural depth, authentic sound and regional imagery without an independent screening or audience verdict.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The most specific adjacent evidence describes Papua filming, eastern Indonesian folklore, character-driven family conflict and production claims about authentic visuals and sound.
lanes.missing_fact: A readable independent review, verified screening reaction or post-release audience response assessing this film's execution.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not grant a quality uplift before release; retain the discovery floor and use an early screening or Day 1 audience evidence to determine whether the distinctive setting translates into satisfaction.

lanes.read: Differentiated but unvalidated positioning: eastern Indonesian Suanggi folklore gives the title a fresher hook than familiar Java-centred horror, while the 21+ classification narrows the reachable audience.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Multiple fetched sources foreground the underused eastern Indonesian cultural setting; the schedule listing identifies an adult 21+ classification.
lanes.decision_consequence: Use the regional-folklore distinction as the sell, especially where that cultural connection may resonate, but keep the opening at the active floor until paid behavior proves broader pull.

lanes.read: Active late-stage digital push: ten captured TikTok results on September 5 used countdowns, cast clips, humor, podcast spillover and repeated September 10 calls to watch, but no proven ticket offer or conversion was captured.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The ten-item TikTok keyword sample shows a concentrated H-5 campaign across several creative formats, all directing attention toward the cinema release.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat campaign activity as evidence that awareness is being worked, not as a reason to exceed the Day 0 floor; the useful next test is whether the push produces paid seats.

lanes.read: Visible reach with shallow conversation: the ten-post TikTok sample accumulated 51,538 views and 1,959 likes, but only 14 comments and 41 shares; the strongest post reached 24,340 views, so attention is present while intent remains unproven.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: One captured TikTok keyword call returned ten samples whose recorded metrics total 51,538 views, 1,959 likes, 14 comments and 41 shares.
lanes.decision_consequence: Akhil should recognize real campaign visibility but withhold a demand upgrade because the sample is promotional, non-representative and weak in discussion or sharing relative to views.

lanes.read: No demonstrated ticket demand: the title is listed as coming soon for September 10 and the captured listing displays nine reminders, but the bundle contains no bookable inventory, paid presales, seat fill or sold-out evidence.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The closest-to-purchase fetched page confirms the release and displays nine Remind Me registrations, which are interest signals rather than transactions.
lanes.missing_fact: Verified SAMS-area showtimes with paid presales, booked-seat counts or another transactional purchase signal.
lanes.decision_consequence: Apply the active Day 0 discovery floor with no pre-result exception; reassess only when booking or Day 1 paid-admission evidence becomes available.

lanes.read: Constrained-audience and false-positive risk: Dewasa 21+ limits access, while promotional reach could be mistaken for demand despite sparse comments, shares and transactional evidence.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The title carries a 21+ classification and its captured social visibility is dominated by campaign posts with only 14 comments and 41 shares across 51,538 sampled views.
lanes.decision_consequence: Keep exposure at the discovery floor and install a fast Day 1 read; weak paid admissions should trigger reduction rather than allowing cultural novelty or campaign volume to protect the title.

ai_rating.source_confidence: High: premise, identity, release, classification and sampled social metrics are corroborated.
ai_rating.sams_relevance: High: eligible Indonesian release dated September 10 on the SAMS public Coming surface.
ai_rating.demand_proximity: Low: nine reminders, but no paid presales, booked seats or SAMS-area occupancy evidence.
ai_rating.promo_social_strength: Medium: active H-5 TikTok push and visible reach, but shallow comments and sharing.
ai_rating.risk_pressure: Medium-high: 21+ access limit and campaign visibility could be mistaken for ticket demand.
ai_rating.actionability: High for learning: Day 1 and Day 4 paid admissions can directly test the folklore-curiosity thesis.

what_milo_sees.title: AGENSI RUMAH TANGGA
what_milo_sees.insight: AGENSI is the strongest broad-reach candidate, but its lead is promotional rather than transactional: recognizable talent, 61,440 peak TikTok views and BOGOF support create visibility while obscuring full-price conversion.
what_milo_sees.room_question: After excluding complimentary entries and separating BOGOF, does AGENSI reach 80% of the median paid admissions per show of IYUS JENIUS, JANGAN LUPA BAHAGIA and SUANGGI: ILMU KUTUKAN within matching site and time bands on Day 1 and cumulatively through Day 4?
what_milo_sees.strengthens_if: AGENSi reaches at least 80% of the frozen three-title median paid admissions per show within matching site and time bands on Day 1 and cumulatively through Day 4, without depending on BOGOF or complimentary traffic.
what_milo_sees.weakens_if: AGENSI remains below 80% of the frozen three-title median on Day 1 and cumulatively through Day 4, or its apparent lead is concentrated in separately reported BOGOF while complimentary entries are excluded.
what_milo_sees.decision_if_unresolved: Conclude that AGENSI leads in visible promotion, not demonstrated demand, until the frozen paid-APS comparison resolves.

public_signal_shape.comparison: Promotion-led signal shape combining talent-led TikTok activity, BOGOF and gala support; the captures do not support a quantitative cross-title comparison.

what_milo_sees.evidence: The relatable package and broad campaign support are real, but no paid sales, occupancy or full-price conversion was captured.

what_milo_sees.title: SUANGGI: ILMU KUTUKAN
what_milo_sees.insight: SUANGGI owns the slate's most differentiated genre proposition, yet its campaign looks curiosity-heavy: 51,538 sampled views produced only 14 comments and 41 shares, while 21+ narrows the reachable audience.
what_milo_sees.room_question: Does the folklore hook produce above-floor paid conversion, or does performance remain at or below the recent local-horror baseline?
what_milo_sees.strengthens_if: Performance remains no better than the local-horror baseline despite the visible campaign.
what_milo_sees.weakens_if: Day 1 exceeds the baseline by at least 20% and Day 4 retains at least 65% of that result.
what_milo_sees.decision_if_unresolved: Conclude that distinctive folklore has earned curiosity, not evidence of incremental ticket demand.

public_signal_shape.comparison: Only 14 comments and 41 shares: 0.27 comments and 0.80 shares per 1,000 views.

what_milo_sees.evidence: The folklore setting is differentiated and promotion is active, but shallow interaction, nine reminders, no transactional signal and the 21+ classification constrain the case.

what_milo_sees.title: IYUS JENIUS
what_milo_sees.insight: IYUS has the weakest scale signal but the clearest audience-shape hypothesis: Papa T. Bob nostalgia, an all-ages format and an 82-minute runtime could concentrate a small child-parent audience in family-timed sessions.

what_milo_sees.weakens_if: On Day 4, the before-17:00 WIB band falls short of a 20% paid-APS premium at at least half of sites with both bands; a tied site count does not pass.
what_milo_sees.decision_if_unresolved: Conclude that IYUS remains an unproven niche proposition, not a demonstrated family draw or a confirmed failure, until the Day 4 two-band test resolves.

what_milo_sees.evidence: The format and nostalgia identify a plausible audience occasion, while thin interaction and only 13 reminders argue against assuming broad demand.

title_hypotheses.title: IYUS JENIUS
title_hypotheses.hypothesis: IYUS JENIUS will open as a low-volume, family-skewed title: on Day 4, its shows starting before 17:00 WIB will achieve at least a 20% paid-admissions-per-show premium over its shows starting at or after 17:00 WIB at a majority of sites with both bands, without broad cross-slot demand.

title_hypotheses.falsifier: The hypothesis is falsified unless, on Day 4, shows starting before 17:00 WIB achieve at least a 20% paid-admissions-per-show premium over the same title's shows starting at or after 17:00 WIB at more than half of the sites with both bands; ties and sites without both bands do not pass.

measurement.comparison: Freeze Day 1 paid admissions per show for IYUS JENIUS in two bands at each site: shows starting before 17:00 WIB and shows starting at or after 17:00 WIB. title_hypotheses.title: JANGAN LUPA BAHAGIA
title_hypotheses.hypothesis: The accessible family-sacrifice premise will produce at least median paid admissions per show versus the same-cycle Indonesian new-release set, despite weak pre-release demand evidence.

title_hypotheses.title: SUANGGI: ILMU KUTUKAN
title_hypotheses.hypothesis: The eastern Indonesian folklore hook will create curiosity but, without demonstrated purchase intent or independent quality evidence, SUANGGI: ILMU KUTUKAN will perform no more than a normal discovery-floor local-horror opening.

title_hypotheses.falsifier: The hypothesis is falsified if a majority of playing sites finish Day 1 at least 20% above their relevant local-horror baseline and retain at least 65% of Day 1 admissions per show by Day 4.

non_consensus_hypothesis.title: IYUS JENIUS
non_consensus_hypothesis.hypothesis: Despite weak public demand evidence, IYUS JENIUS will produce its clearest audience signal through family-timed sessions: on Day 4, its pre-17:00 WIB shows will deliver at least 20% higher paid APS than its 17:00-or-later shows at a majority of sites operating both bands.
non_consensus_hypothesis.evidence: Its all-ages, 82-minute family-musical format and Papa T. Bob nostalgia point to a specific child-parent occasion; 13 reminders and weak social interaction argue for narrowness, not necessarily uniform rejection.
non_consensus_hypothesis.why_non_consensus: A public-signal ranking would place IYUS behind the campaign-heavy titles and may dismiss it as simply low demand, overlooking a falsifiable time-of-day audience shape.
